additional_info.subject: ID0398983-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170004168] FC16 keeps tripping CRM:00315002242
additional_info.body:
Dear Simen,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
T241QR
Problem Description
: FC16 keeps tripping after session is started
Troubleshooting
:
The problem seems to be related to the Contactor or the Fuse itself.
What we tested was, removing the cables from the XD441 and XD442:
QA09 - XD441:8C
QA10 - XD442:14C
QA11 - XD441:10C
QA12 - XD442:16C
All of them showed around 300-400kOhm which is correct with our values in TC.
We checked XD9.1B/A, removed and plugged back in → no issues it seems
Checked XD12.1 and also all properly attached.
We changed FC16 with FC17 to see if there is any problem with FC16.
If we have an error in FC16 (which is now in FC17), then we have a faulty fuse
If we have an error in the new FC16 (FC17), then it means we still have a problem in the circuit.
I will send this ticket to your queue for Monitoring purposes. Please reach out to me immediately if you find something new.
For future reference, your case number is
0398983
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
